title: Treasury Course Demo Pack
currencyStandard: INR-first with explicit generic-currency labels where INR is not yet implemented
notes: This pack references demos already implemented elsewhere in the repository.
The pack controls teaching sequence and classroom framing, not demo ownership.
Non-blockchain treasury flow is prioritized for the first implementation pass.

demos.title: Treasury Control Tower
demos.learningObjective: Frame treasury decision-making across liquidity, controls, and alerts before moving into deeper analytics.
demos.participantTask: Adjust core controls and explain how the operating picture changes.
demos.deliverable: Short control-tower interpretation and top-three action list

demos.title: Invoice-Level Collections Prediction
demos.learningObjective: Predict when invoices are likely to be paid and compare contractual versus ML-adjusted inflow timing.
demos.participantTask: Compare due-date and expected-payment-date inflows over 7, 14, and 30 days.
demos.deliverable: Payment calendar, collections action queue, and model-risk statement

demos.title: O2C Process Mining Workbench
demos.learningObjective: Diagnose how receivables actually flow before selecting workflow, RPA, or AI interventions.
demos.participantTask: Compare the happy path with actual O2C variants and classify each issue as eliminate, standardize, enable, assure, or monitor.
demos.deliverable: O2C process-friction note with action choices and control-owner implications

demos.title: O2C Process Mining Notebook
demos.learningObjective: Make the event-log calculations transparent so participants can inspect assumptions behind O2C process-mining metrics.
demos.participantTask: Run the notebook, inspect the variant and exception calculations, and test how different assumptions change the finance conclusion.
demos.deliverable: Annotated notebook observations and a metric-assumption challenge note

demos.title: P2P Process Mining Workbench
demos.learningObjective: Diagnose how AP and P2P work actually flows before selecting workflow, RPA, or AI interventions.
demos.participantTask: Compare the AP happy path with actual variants and classify each issue as eliminate, standardize, enable, assure, or monitor.
demos.deliverable: P2P process-friction note with action choices and control-owner implications

demos.title: P2P Process Mining Notebook
demos.learningObjective: Make the AP event-log calculations transparent so participants can inspect assumptions behind process-mining metrics.
demos.participantTask: Run the notebook, inspect the variant and exception calculations, and test how different assumptions change the finance conclusion.
demos.deliverable: Annotated notebook observations and a metric-assumption challenge note

demos.title: AR Aging and Collections Prioritizer
demos.learningObjective: Translate receivables signals into a collections worklist with operational prioritization.
demos.participantTask: Rank customers by urgency and justify the chosen outreach order.
demos.deliverable: Collections priority list and owner assignment logic

demos.title: Dell vs Competitors Working Capital Case
demos.learningObjective: Connect receivables timing to broader working-capital strategy and cash release logic.
demos.participantTask: Interpret how DSO shifts change cash freed across companies.
demos.deliverable: Working-capital comparison note and one treasury implication

demos.title: Liquidity Management
demos.learningObjective: Relate predicted inflows to short-term funding posture and concentration risk.
demos.participantTask: Explain how forecast changes alter liquidity actions.
